ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
ወአውሥአት: አውሥአ — and she answered (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative, w-ś-ʾ)
ወትቤሎሙ: ይቤ — and she said to them (ወ- + 3fs perfect ትቤ of the irregular verb 'say' + ሎሙ 'to them')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ዘትብሉ: ብህለ — what you say (ዘ- + 2mp imperfect, b-h-l)
አብ: አብ — father (the Father) · a father in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ)
ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will')
ለአምላከ: አምላክ — of the God of (ለ- genitive + noun, construct) · marking the object: 'the God of' after ያመልኩ/ይግነዩ (ይግነዩ ለአምላከ እስራኤል 'serve the God of Israel')
ወሰብአ: ሰብእ — and men (ወ- + noun; construct 'men of' in ሰብአ ቤቱ 'his household')
ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion') · naming the owner after a suffix (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'the seat of Zion'; እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon Zion', ch. 56)
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ዘንትዐደው: ተዐደወ — that we transgress (ዘ- relative + tä-stem 1cp imperf., ʿ-d-w)
መርሐ: መርሕ — guide, leader (noun, predicate accusative after ይኩንከ; the same spelling could be a 3ms perfect 'he guided') (?)
በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am')
እምኵሉ: ኵሉ — out of all, from all (እም- 'from' + ኵሉ)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
ሠናይ: ሠናይ — good, beautiful (adj.) · 'good' as a substantive (ዘይረክበከ ሠናይ 'what good will find you')
ለዝንቱ: ዝንቱ — to this one (ለ- + m. demonstrative) · ለ- marking the object, repeating the suffix on the verb (ለዝንቱ ወሬዛ, ለዝንቱ ሕፃን 'this lad, this child')
አእምሮ: አእምሮ — knowledge, understanding (noun; verbal noun of አእመረ)
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
ዘከመዝ: ዘከመዝ — such, thus, in this way (ዘ- + ከመ + ዝ)
ጥበብሰ: ጥበብ — wisdom, as for her (noun, fem. + contrastive -ሰ) · 'as for wisdom' (ጥበብ + the topic-marking -ሰ: ጥበብሰ ወልቡና እምኔኪ ሠረጸት)
ወአእምሮ: አእምሮ — and knowledge (ወ- + verbal noun of አእመረ)
ታበርህ: አብርሀ — she shines (3fs imperfect, causative of በርሀ 'be bright'; subject Zion)
ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for')
ቦሙ: በ — by them, in them (preposition በ- + -ሙ '3mp', ቦሙ)
ወአንሰ: አነ — and as for me (ወ- 'and' + 1s pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
ወያጸግብ: አጸገበ — and it satisfies (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ጸገበ 'be sated')
በብሔረ: ብሔር — in the land of (በ- + noun, construct state)
ወላህበ: ላህብ — and the flame, burning heat of (ወ- + noun, construct)
ለንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — to the king, for the king (ለ- + noun) · marking the object, doubled by a suffix on the verb (ይሕምይዎ ለንጉሥ 'they revile the king') or by a suffix on a noun (ሐሚዮቱ ለንጉሥ 'the reviling of the king') · 'of the king', owner after an anticipating suffix (ኅይስናሁ ለንጉሥ 'the worth of the king')
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
ተግሕሠ: ተግሕሠ — he turned aside (3ms perfect, tä-g-ḥ-ś; uncertain stem)
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
ዘበአማን: አማን — truly, in truth (ዘ- + በ- + noun; adverbial 'true, veritable')
አንሰ: አነ — as for me (1cs pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ቅዱሰ: ቅዱስ — holy one (noun/adjective, construct 'holy one of', in ቅዱሰ እስራኤል)
ቅዱሳን: ቅዱስ — holy ones, holies (plural ቅዱሳን; ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'Holy of Holies')
ለጥበብ: ጥበብ — to wisdom, of wisdom (ለ- + noun; names the object or possessor already marked by a suffix)
ወኢይትገደፍ: ተገድፈ — and it is not cast away (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, passive of ገደፈ)
እንበር: ነበረ — that I stay, dwell (1cs subjunctive, G, n-b-r)
በእንቲአሃ: በእንተ — for her, on her account (preposition በእንተ with 3fs suffix -ሃ, stem በእንቲአ-)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
ወአኀዝኩ: አኀዘ — and I began, took hold (ወ- + 1sg perfect, ʾ-ḫ-z; with following verb 'began to')
መዓምቅቲሃ: ዕመቅ — its depths (noun, plural መዓምቅት + -ሃ '3fs its'; lemma/plural uncertain) (?)
ወረድኩ: ወረደ — I went down, go down (1cs perfect, G, w-r-d; conditional after ወእመኒ 'even if')
ኀጺን: ኀጺን — iron (noun; በአፈ ኀጺን 'by the edge of iron', i.e. the sword)
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
አሕማር: አሕማር — red (borrowed Arabic masculine singular adjective, cf. Arabic aḥmar)
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?)
ሊተ: ሊተ — to me, me (1s pronoun, dative/oblique)
በአሕባለ: ሐብል — with cords of (በ- + plural አሕባል, construct)
ለባሕር: ባሕር — to/over the sea (ለ- + noun) · 'for the sea' (ተላህያ ለባሕር 'delight (?) for the sea', ch. 55)
ወዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — and without (ወ- + preposition) · 'and before' + subjunctive (ወዘእንበለ ታጥብዎ 'and before she could nurse him')
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity') · 'of the world', the owner after an anticipating suffix (ብርሃኖ ለዓለም 'the light of the world') · 'for ever' also after ካህኑ: 'his priest for ever', or 'priest of the world' (?)
ቦእኩ: ቦአ — I entered (1cs perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
ለኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — to all of them, all of them (ለ- + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp'; the ለ- marks the object)
ሖሩ: ሖረ — they went (3mp perfect, ḥ-w-r) · go! (2mp imperative, ሖሩ በመንፈስ 'go in the spirit')
ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
የሐውሩ: ሖረ — they go (3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
ሙ: ሙ — -ሙ, detached pronominal suffix; it completes the preceding እምኔክ as እምኔክሙ 'from you (pl.)' (suffix, 2mp) · here completing አባሕኩክ as አባሕኩክሙ 'I … you (pl.)' (suffix -ሙ, 2mp, split from its word by the wordspace)
ወሀበነ: ወሀበ — he gave us (3ms perfect, G, w-h-b + -ነ '1cp us'; the ወ is a root letter)
ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
በጽዮን: ጽዮን — by Zion (በ- + proper name, after ተማሕፀነ 'adjure by')
ወማኅደረ: ማኅደር — and dwelling-place of (ወ- + noun, construct)
ወዓዲ: ዓዲ — and still, also, moreover (ወ- + adverb)
ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine') · 'it was' of time (ሶበ ኮነ ጊዜ ድራር 'when it was time for supper'); ወኮነ ፀዋገ 'he became (grim)'
እሙንቱሰ: እሙንቱ — they indeed, they for their part (3mp pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
ወንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — and as for us (ወ- + 1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ኀስሩ: ኀሠረ — they were diminished (3mp perfect, G, ḫ-s-r; spelled with ስ; subject አእሩገ እስራኤል 'elders of Israel')

ለዓለመ: ዓለም — age, world, eternity (noun, construct state 'age-of'; ለ- 'for')
ዘይመጽእ: መጽአ — who comes (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
ወአንትሙኒ: አንትሙ — and you too (ወ- + 2mp pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
ስምዑኒ: ሰምዐ — hear me! (G 2mp imperative with suffix 1cs -ኒ)
ጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — righteousness, justice (noun; ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness')
በበይናቲክሙ: በይነ — among yourselves (?) (በ- + the stem በይን- of በይነ 'between' + plural -ት- + -ክሙ '2mp your'; the doubled በ is not the distributive) (?)
